message:
README: Fix Automatic OPTIONS responses and CORS example bug (#314)

Fixes #312

pr.title: README: Fix Automatic OPTIONS responses and CORS example bug

linkedIssues.title: Example for 'Automatic OPTIONS responses and CORS' has a bug
linkedIssues.body:
When adding CORS headers through the example 'Automatic OPTIONS responses and CORS', I found that the header 'Access-Control-Allow-Methods' had an empty string.

```
$ curl -XOPTIONS -I -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST" http://localhost:8080/test
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Access-Control-Allow-Methods:
Allow: OPTIONS, POST
Date: <not important>
```
My expected result would be:
```
$ curl -XOPTIONS -I -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST" http://localhost:8080/test
HTTP/1.1 204 No Content
Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
Access-Control-Allow-Methods: OPTIONS, POST
Allow: OPTIONS, POST
Date: <not important>
```
Looking at the code, shouldn't it be `w.Header().Get("Allow")` rather than `r.Header.Get("Allow")`? I don't think I have, but sorry if I missed anything here!

diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index d1e68b5..29d35db 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -156,7 +156,7 @@ router.GlobalOPTIONS = http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Requ
     if r.Header.Get("Access-Control-Request-Method") != "" {
         // Set CORS headers
         header := w.Header()
-        header.Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", r.Header.Get("Allow"))
+        header.Set("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", header.Get("Allow"))
         header.Set("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
     }

explanation.what: READMEのCORS対応例(GlobalOPTIONSハンドラ)で、`Access-Control-Allow-Methods`ヘッダーに`r.Header.Get("Allow")`(リクエストヘッダー)を渡していたのを`header.Get("Allow")`(レスポンスヘッダー、`w.Header()`で取得済みの変数)に修正した。
explanation.why: issue #312 の報告によれば、この例をそのまま使うと`Access-Control-Allow-Methods`が常に空文字列になる不具合があった。`Allow`ヘッダーはリクエストではなくレスポンス側(ルータが自動設定したもの)に入っているため、参照先を取り違えていたのが原因。

highlights.note: CORSサンプルコードのヘッダー参照元の修正(1行)
